Recently, "instant bans" and "demonetization" of investment-related YouTube channels have been increasing at an abnormal pace.

I summarized the reasons for suspensions and bans related to investment by comparing them with YouTube's policies.

Or rather, I'm pasting the results of asking Gemini

The output images are from a quick Gemini chat, so the slide styles are all different, but never mind lol

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 1. Reasons for instant account bans
(Community Guidelines violations)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The notified reasons for the recent wave of account bans are almost without exception violations of the "spam, deceptive practices and scams policy". There are three main causes.

① Overlap between external-guidance links and "SNS-type investment fraud"
The classic pattern of investment fraud that is a social problem now is the flow "video → official LINE or closed Discord → guidance to products or overseas FX in a closed environment".
As a result, even legitimately run channels that merely keep "official LINE / Discord / overseas brokerage affiliate" links permanently in the description are judged by the strengthened monitoring AI as "external-guidance spam of the same type as fraud groups" and are hit with instant bans without warning.

② Accumulation of "sensational expressions" in thumbnails and titles
Under the policy, expressions that mislead people into thinking they will "surely make money in a short time (get rich quick)" are out. Even serious market commentary, if it repeatedly uses strongly assertive words such as "buy now", "guaranteed surge" and "tenbagger" to chase CTR (click-through rate), accumulates a fraud score in the AI's image and text analysis and gets banned the moment it exceeds the threshold.

③ "Mass reporting" trigger in live streams
A phenomenon especially notable in live streams such as FX: viewers who mirror-traded the streamer's positions and got stopped out in a sudden market move take revenge by all reporting "fraud/spam" at once. If a flood of reports comes in a short time while there is an external link in the description, the AI's automatic freeze trigger activates immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ 2. Reasons for demonetization (removal)
(YPP: monetization policy violations)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
In cases where the channel remains but only monetization is stripped (especially impersonal, "Yukkuri" explainer and AI-voice types), the tightening of the monetization policy is hitting directly.

① Clear regulation of "YMYL × AI personas"
The current YouTube monetization policy explicitly lists as an example of content not eligible for monetization "AI-generated hosts (AI personas) providing financial guidance, investment tips or asset management advice".
In YMYL areas such as finance, the very format in which a non-existent AI character or synthetic voice talks about investment decisions is shut out at the policy level.

② Judgment as mass-produced, repetitive content
Videos that simply pour earnings information, economic news, chart screens and social media reactions into a template and read it out in synthetic voice are deemed "mass-produced content without original added value", and cases of monetization being stripped even from past videos are mounting.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
■ The boundary with channels that survive
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Under today's algorithm, the boundary between "dangerous operation" and "safe operation" is quite clear.

【Extremely risky (could be banned at any time)】
・Permanently placing official LINE / closed Discord / overseas FX affiliate links in the description
・Thumbnails that urge buying, such as "guaranteed profit" or "buy this stock"
・Stock recommendations or chart read-outs using AI voice or templated screens
・A "leading style" that prompts viewers on trade timing

【Low risk (structures that tend to survive)】
・No external guidance (completed within YouTube, e.g. memberships)
・Objective explanations of macroeconomics or historical data, reports of one's own profit and loss
・Real human voice, or a structure with original visualization or deep primary analysis
・"Self-contained entertainment" showing one's own trading results (including huge losses)

The scariest thing is that once a ban for "spam/fraud" is confirmed, if the appeal is rejected, there is a risk of chain bans extending to other channels of the same operator under the "prohibition on circumventing suspension" policy.

Not only investment: in other genres such as business and side jobs, the combination of "external links in the description (especially LINE and Discord)" and "sensational thumbnails" is also being targeted by AI monitoring, so channel operators would be wise to clean up even the descriptions of past videos now.

【Attention】Can overseas FX bank deposits/withdrawals be used until May 2028?

There is a possibility, but in practice it is considered difficult.

📌Why May 2028?
Payment agents that were already operating as of the enforcement date of the amended Payment Services Act (June 1, 2026) can continue operating without registration for up to 2 years (until the end of May 2028) while the review result is pending, provided they apply for registration within 6 months of enforcement (by November 30, 2026).

⚠️The registration refusal requirements are the problem
In its response to the public comments, the Financial Services Agency stated clearly that payment agency services for overseas businesses not registered in Japan "fall under the registration refusal requirements and registration will not be granted", even if they apply.

If a refusal is issued, such a payment agent can no longer continue at that point without waiting for May 2028, and as the review progresses, more payment agents may drop out💦

If you continue to use them, you should also consider using crypto transfers.

【Why overseas FX traders should consider incorporating right now】

The commonly said "incorporate after profits get big" is too late.
It's like buying fire insurance after the house has burned down.

In fact, with overseas FX, the best time to incorporate is while you're losing.

There are two reasons.

① Offsetting profits and losses against other businesses
② Loss carryforward for up to 10 years

In fact, until a few years ago I was making huge profits in other businesses including affiliate, while taking huge losses in overseas FX.

But thanks to being incorporated, I could offset profits against losses and greatly reduce my tax burden.

And recently I've finally become able to win at trading too.
This time the carried-forward losses left over from my past huge losses are compressing my current profits.

With individual overseas FX, losses in principle cannot be carried forward to the following years.
But a company can carry them forward for up to 10 years.

In other words, I benefited while I was losing, and I'm benefiting after becoming able to win.

If I hadn't incorporated back when I was taking huge losses in FX, my cumulative taxable income might have been more than 100 million yen higher.

Just imagining it makes my whole body of fat tremble.
That's how big the benefit of incorporation has been for me.

Of course there are company maintenance costs, and I'm not recommending it to everyone.

But if you're serious about winning in the future, it's worth considering incorporation early.

My past huge losses protect my future huge profits.

That is the biggest reason I push for incorporation.
